record.dic_text:
0549 'Amanah {a-ma:-na:'}

與 0548 同; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Amana 1, variant for Abana 1; 2

亞瑪拿 = "支持"
1) 一條從安替黎巴嫩山脈流入大馬色平原的河流
  (#王下 5:12|; 中文聖經採取用 071, 譯作"亞罷拿")
2) 河流源頭山區的範圍 (#歌 4:8|)
record.edic_text:
0549 'Amanah {am-aw-naw'}

the same as 0548;; n pr loc

AV - Amana 1, variant for Abana 1; 2

Amana = "support"
1) a river flowing into the plain of Damascus from Antilebanon
2) mountainous area of the river's origin
